title: Runner contract errors
description: The error codes the runner contract defines, for a runner to answer a request it can't serve. A runner's own codes are published by the runner (docs/runners.md, Publishing a runner's schemas).

oneOf.description: The request isn't JSON. JSON-RPC code -32700.
The message isn't a JSON-RPC 2.0 request. JSON-RPC code -32600.
A request other than initialize came before initialize. JSON-RPC code -32600.
The method isn't one the runner serves. JSON-RPC code -32601.
None of the offered protocol versions is one the runner supports. JSON-RPC code -32000.

supportedVersions.description: The protocol versions the runner supports.

oneOf.description: A second run/start to a runner process already serving a run. JSON-RPC code -32000.
The params aren't the ones the contract defines for the method. JSON-RPC code -32602.
